name: Localism
summary: Localism prioritises the local over the national or global: decisions should be taken by the people affected, economies should be rooted in local production and consumption, and communities should be small enough for members to know one another. It spans decentralist and green thinkers who distrust bigness and policy programmes that devolve powers to councils and neighbourhoods.
scope: The mainstream 20th-century decentralist and green strand (Leopold Kohr, E. F. Schumacher, Wendell Berry) together with the policy localism of devolution and subsidiarity, as in the UK Localism Act 2011. It excludes ethnic or separatist nationalism, which uses local identity differently, and treats populist localism as a secondary variant. Most social and cultural questions are not addressed by the ideology and are answered neutrally or at low confidence.

keyFigures.name: Wendell Berry

sources.author: Wendell Berry, quoted on imonk.blog
sources.usedFor: Berry's own quoted words on household economies, local loyalty, thrift, and the ruling ideas of competition, consumption and globalism.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Localism has no health-care doctrine; adherents would accept guaranteed care but prefer it organised and run through local bodies, so this is inferred from its community orientation.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Localists split: some back living wages to keep money circulating locally, others fear a national wage floor burdens small local firms, and sources give no line.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Berry and Schumacher fault the global market's ruling ideas of competition and consumption, though localists still favour small local markets over state planning.

public-ownership.rationale: Schumacher wanted nationalised industry made more democratic, but localists generally prefer community, cooperative or small private ownership to remote national ownership; inferred.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Localism does not address progressive taxation; the stress is on where power and money sit, not on rates, so adherents split.

unions-good.rationale: Cooperation among households, farms and workers is a localist value, but unions as such are not discussed; mild inferred support.

property-fundamental.rationale: Berry values land held by those who work it, yet localists accept community limits on property, so adherents split.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Kohr and Berry see large corporations as enabling exploitation and homogenising communities, which supports tighter control of big firms.

cut-welfare.rationale: Not a localist theme; localists favour community mutual aid and would not prioritise cutting welfare, though some want it run locally; inferred.

worker-ownership.rationale: Localism endorses workers' councils and small community-scale enterprise, but collective worker ownership is not a defining demand.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Localism's stress on autonomous communities and citizen participation implies wariness of central security powers; inferred, not stated.

legalize-drugs.rationale: No localist position; many would leave the decision to local communities rather than set a national answer.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Not addressed by localist sources; adherents range from civil-libertarian to communitarian.

strong-leader.rationale: Kohr argued that power concentrates dangerously in big units; localism's whole logic is dispersed power, against a strong leader overriding local say.

limit-guns.rationale: Left to local and community decision under localism, and rural and urban localists differ.

empower-police-military.rationale: Localists distrust large central apparatuses; they would favour local policing over a stronger military, inferred from Kohr's critique of big-state power.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: No localist doctrine; likely devolved to local decision.

decide-locally.rationale: The ideology's defining claim: decisions belong with those affected, and centralisation that erodes local power is rejected.

rehabilitation.rationale: Not addressed; localists would stress community-based justice but sources give no direction on punishment.

traditional-family.rationale: Berry stresses household economies and community ties, but localism as a family is split between traditionalist and green-left strands.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: No localist position; communities themselves are divided and many adherents want it left to local choice.

abortion-legal.rationale: Not addressed and adherents split across the spectrum.

more-religion-public.rationale: Congregationalist autonomy is a localist idea, but there is no stance on religion's public role.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Not a localist theme; adherents are split.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Localists value local culture and history, but the national scale is not their unit and Kohr saw nations as artificial mixtures.

gradual-change.rationale: Berry's emphasis on thrift, familiarity and rootedness leans conservative, while green localists seek deep change; split.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Sources note only a brain-drain objection to emigration from poor countries; there is no common localist stance on immigration levels.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Kohr opposed continental and global unions as dominated by large powers, and localists favour power moving downward, not upward.

free-trade.rationale: Localists are aligned with anti-globalisation critics and want local production and consumption, with some seeking to minimise trade.

nation-first.rationale: Localists reject the national scale as the unit of loyalty, but they also oppose global cooperation that overrides local control; split.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Kohr tied aggression to size and opposed great-power projection; inferred wariness of intervention abroad.

open-borders.rationale: Localism prizes bounded, knowable communities, so open borders sit awkwardly; inferred and contested.

limit-growth.rationale: Schumacher's enoughness and Berry's critique of consumption lead green localists to favour limits on growth.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Green movements often include localist variants and localists see local decision-making as better for environmental issues, though they stress local rather than state-led action.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Schumacher favoured appropriate technology and warned that technology alone cannot fix an unsustainable system.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Large centralised plants clash with human-scale technology; inferred from Schumacher's appropriate-technology view.

revolution-justified.rationale: Localism works through devolution and community action, not revolution; inferred.

experts-over-public.rationale: Berry complains that government and academic experts persuade rural people they cannot provide for themselves; localism trusts local knowledge over remote expertise.

central-planning.rationale: Kohr and Schumacher oppose concentrated economic power and bigness; central planning is the opposite of local control.

socialized-markets.rationale: Cooperatives and community enterprises fit local economies, but localism does not define markets by ownership; inferred.

land-value-tax.rationale: No localist position on this tax.

basic-income.rationale: Not addressed; localists would prefer community-level support but there is no consensus.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: The buy-local strand is described as partly protectionist, aiming to protect local producers.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Berry wants local capital put to work locally, not directed from above by central government.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Berry favours small farms, independent businesses and local ownership rather than concentration in corporations.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Localism favours local markets and independent small businesses, so abolishing money is not a goal; inferred.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Community banks and credit unions are a localist theme, but abolishing central banks is not addressed.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: State-recognised bodies setting wages are not localist; localists prefer community and workplace agreements, inferred.

one-party-rule.rationale: Localism affines with deliberative democracy and citizen participation, and rejects concentrated power.

democracy-best.rationale: Localism has affinities with deliberative democracy and citizen participation, though it prefers local democracy to national.

direct-votes.rationale: The Localism Act expanded local referendums, and participatory democracy is a localist theme.

workers-councils.rationale: The Wikipedia article lists workers' councils as examples of small community bodies, but they are not a core demand.

right-to-secede.rationale: Kohr advocated splitting large states into small autonomous units, and localism supports local self-government.

natural-rulers.rationale: Localism's emphasis on citizen participation and local control is egalitarian and contradicts rule by a natural elite.

political-violence-never.rationale: Kohr and Schumacher offer non-violent smallness as the cure for aggression; no explicit statement, inferred.

war-builds-character.rationale: Kohr argued that size causes aggression and war, which localists see as a harm.

separate-church-state.rationale: Not addressed apart from congregational autonomy.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Not a localist position; localists favour democratic local choice, inferred.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Localists favour community and local authority, not commercial provision of justice; inferred.

military-superiority.rationale: Great-power rivalry is blamed on size by Kohr; localists do not seek superiority; inferred.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Localism can be civic or cultural rather than ethnic, as in Yeung's Hong Kong example, and Kohr saw nations as mixtures.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Localism stresses community cooperation, not class conflict; inferred.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Localist sources say nothing on equality of outcomes; adherents range from egalitarian greens to conservative communitarians.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Local control by those who live on and know the land fits localism; not stated specifically.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Reparations between states are outside localism's concerns, and no localist source takes a side.

civilizational-union.rationale: Kohr opposed pan-nationalist and continental unions as dominated by the largest member.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Berry stresses neighbourliness and local loyalty but not subordinating rights.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Berry lists thrift, reverence, neighbourliness and cooperation against the ruling ideas of competition and consumption.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Berry's reverence and attention to place and Edward Goldsmith's call to restore natural systems point toward valuing nature in itself, though it is not their central claim.

limit-population.rationale: Not a core localist issue; some greens say yes, others no.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Schumacher criticises the modern economy as unsustainable and Berry laments the loss of household economies, but most localists reform rather than reject industrial society.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Schumacher's appropriate technology and warnings on technology's human impact are the opposite of speeding disruptive change.

human-enhancement.rationale: Human-scale technology and enoughness imply scepticism; inferred.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Remote algorithmic decision-making removes decisions from those affected, against localism's core.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Encryption policy is not a localist topic; sources give no basis for a view either way.

restore-past-order.rationale: Berry recovers older local virtues and household economies, but localism is not defined as restoring a lost order.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Localism is a scale-based approach with no stated view on pragmatism versus ideology; adherents split.

direct-action.rationale: Localists favour community action but also use local elections and statutes, so split.

means-match-ends.rationale: Community participation as both method and aim is implied; not stated directly.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Localists want rebuilt local farming and household economies, not abandoning agriculture.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Berry favours cooperation among farms, factories and banks and does not call for abolishing specialisation; inferred.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Localist sources do not discuss distribution by need versus work; mutual aid in small communities is consistent with either.

production-for-use.rationale: Local production and consumption for community needs fits the buy-local strand, though it is not framed against profit.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Kohr saw large firms as enabling exploitation, but localism does not adopt a labour theory of profit.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Concentrated power of any kind is what Kohr and localists oppose.

collective-farming.rationale: Berry champions small family and community farms, not state-collectivised ones; inferred.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Kohr blamed size, not capitalism, for war.

taxation-theft.rationale: Local government with a general power of competence assumes taxation is legitimate; inferred.

harm-principle.rationale: Not addressed; communitarian localists accept more community norms.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Localism emphasises communities as bearers of self-government, which sits uneasily with an individual-only view.

conscription.rationale: Localists distrust large central military power; inferred.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Localism stresses voice and citizen participation in local government rather than exit.

state-as-business.rationale: Citizens as customers rather than participants cuts against deliberative, participatory local democracy.

positive-liberty.rationale: The positive versus negative liberty debate is not addressed by localist sources; adherents split.

media-academia-power.rationale: Not addressed; populist localists may say yes, others no.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Not part of localism and civic localism rejects ethnic grounds; inferred.

organic-representation.rationale: Representation through local communities and community councils fits the localist picture, though trade-body representation is less so.

total-state.rationale: Total state direction is the extreme of the concentrated power Kohr and localists reject.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Kohr tied aggression to big states and sought smaller units.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Not localist; inferred from its democratic orientation.

bound-labor.rationale: Localism favours participation and local self-government, not bondage.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Localists prize local knowledge, but no source adopts the claim that knowledge reflects power; left neutral.

universal-morality.rationale: Berry stresses particular places but also moral virtues; not decided.

single-common-good.rationale: Localists stress deliberation among different communities; inferred.

revive-national-language.rationale: Localism supports local culture and identity, but a state language is a national matter; not stated.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Fits participation and community-scale enterprise; inferred.

school-vouchers.rationale: Localists favour local control of schools but vouchers are not addressed.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Fiscal policy is not addressed by localism; the question concerns national macroeconomics, not scale.

economic-freedom.rationale: Localist sources do not link political and economic freedom; Berry criticises markets while valuing small independent owners.

rule-by-example.rationale: Localism does not discuss rulers' moral example; its concern is who decides, not how they lead.

national-self-determination.rationale: Kohr preferred small units to nation-states, while localists support self-government at every level, so they split on the national scale.

force-without-un.rationale: Inferred from Kohr's scepticism of great-power force.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Berry's reverence and humility sit alongside reason, and no localist source ranks them; left neutral.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Not addressed; some localists favour residency-based eligibility.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Welfare conditionality is not a localist theme; adherents split between community reciprocity and unconditional support.

class-collaboration.rationale: Berry's cooperation among households, farms, factories and banks implies partnership; inferred.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Localism values local history, culture and identity, so sacrificing heritage is rejected.

dominated-front.rationale: A common front of dominated countries is not addressed; Kohr opposed large blocs of any kind, so no clear stance.

workers-nation.rationale: Organising the working class on national lines is outside localism, which neither stresses class nor the national scale.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Gender roles in public life are not addressed by localist sources; traditionalist and progressive localists differ.

ban-interest.rationale: Community banks and credit unions are localist institutions; inferred.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Civic localism is not ethnic, and nothing in localist sources supports legal racial segregation.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Localism offers no theory of the state as a class tool; Kohr blames size, not class, for abuse of power.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Schumacher treated fossil fuels as depletable capital, and green localists favour limits.

elite-replacement.rationale: Fringe conspiracy claim not part of localism; inferred.

proportional-representation.rationale: Electoral systems are not a localist concern; some stress local constituency links while others favour proportionality.

national-mission.rationale: Kohr opposed big-power ambition and imposition on others.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Structural patriarchy is not discussed in localist sources; adherents range across the spectrum.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Wills calls localist politicians anti-politics, opposing mainstream politics, and populist localism criticises distant elites.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Eugenics has no basis in localist sources and conflicts with community-based, participatory values.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Accountability for past security-force abuses is not addressed; localists would favour local accountability but give no source for it.

night-watchman-state.rationale: The Localism Act empowers councils to do anything individuals may, which is far from a minimal state.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Not supported by civic localism; inferred.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Not explicitly discussed in localist sources; inferred from its participatory orientation.

socialism-one-country.rationale: This is a debate internal to Marxism and localism takes no part in it.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Localism does not address whether settler states are colonial; no source supports a stance.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Localism favours diverse local rules over uniform national ones; inferred from decentralisation.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Congregational autonomy implies religious freedom; inferred.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Not addressed; left to local decision.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Religious instruction in schools is not discussed; localists would likely leave it to local decision, so adherents split.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Concentrated state strength runs against Kohr's view and localism's core.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Localism holds that decisions should be made by those affected and has affinities with deliberative democracy.

trade-surplus.rationale: Localists seek local self-sufficiency, not national export drives; inferred.

population-transfer.rationale: Civic localism is non-ethnic and community-based; no source endorses expulsion.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Non-aggression as an absolute is a libertarian principle that localist sources do not endorse or reject.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Berry lists competition among the ruling ideas he opposes, preferring cooperation.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Banning anti-constitutional parties is not addressed; participatory localists and civil-libertarian ones differ.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Kohr's concern about concentrated power is related, but the republican concept is not part of localism.

separated-powers.rationale: Distributing power across tiers of government through devolution and the Localism Act reflects checks and dispersal.

vanguard-party.rationale: Localism's participatory, community orientation rejects vanguard leadership.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Localist sources do not say that institutions should prioritise the poor; community solidarity is valued but no ranking is stated.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: The Localism Act is about community rights over assets, not tenants' purchase rights; not addressed.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Strike law is not addressed by localism, which values cooperation among workers and firms but offers no rule.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Berry blames displacement from land and dependent consumption, not population.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Localists prize close-knit community but civic localism is not ethnic; split.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Deliberative democracy affinity but lottery is not a localist doctrine.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Price controls are not discussed; local self-sufficiency in food is valued but fixed prices are not mentioned.

party-controls-media.rationale: Contradicts citizen participation and deliberative democracy.

party-commands-army.rationale: Party-state control is the opposite of localism.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Naturalisation periods are not a localist topic; sources address emigration brain drain only.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Representatives' pay is not addressed by localist sources, though citizen-politician ideals would be sympathetic.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Party discipline is not addressed; localists often favour independent local councillors, but no source states it.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Kohr opposed supranational unions dominated by the biggest member, and localists want power devolved downward.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Concentration in a single head is inferred as opposed.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Congregationalist church autonomy is a localist idea.

clerical-rule.rationale: Concentrated clerical authority conflicts with local self-government.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Revolutionary defeatism is a Marxist doctrine that localism does not discuss.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Censorship for moral character is not addressed in localist sources; communitarian and liberal localists differ.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Concentrated, entrenched office is out of keeping with participatory local politics; inferred.

recall-officials.rationale: Citizen participation and local accountability support recall.

people-in-arms.rationale: An armed citizenry is not a stated localist position, though militia ideas fit local self-defence; no source supports it.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Berry argues for rebuilding the land-community connection and values rural diversity and small farming.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Kohr preferred small units over big states, but not addressed directly.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Berry criticises academic experts, but localism does not blanket-condemn the educated.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Not addressed; localists value particular cultures but make no ranking claims.

death-penalty.rationale: The death penalty is not a localist topic; it is typically a national legal question with adherents divided.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Not addressed; left to local choice.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Curriculum content is not addressed by localist sources; local control of schools is plausible but the content question is open.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Pornography regulation is not addressed; communitarians and liberals within localism differ.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Citizenship rules are not addressed by localism; Yeung's civic localism cuts against descent-based criteria but is not decisive.

minority-language-support.rationale: Localism supports local culture and identity, and Kohr warned big unions erode smaller languages.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Religious exemptions are not discussed, though congregational autonomy suggests some sympathy; adherents split.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Mill's argument on conformity is not part of localism, and close-knit community values pull the other way; left neutral.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Kohr opposed massive foreign aid for stifling local initiative, but debt is not addressed.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Localist sources do not tie political independence to property-system change; no stance.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Constitution-making procedure is not addressed by localist sources.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Localists criticise growth-first models and favour participation.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Kohr opposed massive foreign aid as stifling local initiative, while Monbiot-style critics differ.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Great-power arms are inferred as rejected.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Selection of the head of state is not a localist issue, since the doctrine concerns the local scale.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Central banking is not addressed; localists favour community banks but say nothing on central bank independence.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Territorial concessions in peace deals are not a localist question, so no source supports a view.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Berry's local loyalty and community ties imply property carries community obligations; inferred.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: The character of the Soviet Union is a Marxist debate outside localism.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Schumacher's warning about non-renewable resources and limited absorption capacity supports precaution.

collective-defense.rationale: Alliances of states are inferred as disfavoured by Kohr.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: International law on annexation is not addressed by localist sources, though Kohr opposed big-state expansion.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Congregational autonomy opposes state control of churches; inferred.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: A ceremonial non-partisan head of state is not addressed by localism.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Kohr supported disunion and smaller units.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Devolved autonomy within a larger state is a localist structure.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Tax rate structure is not discussed in localist sources.

character-from-environment.rationale: Berry stresses place and community formation but this is not stated as a doctrine.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Unbound rulers are the extreme of concentrated power.

space-expansion.rationale: Appropriate-scale and Earth-bound values suggest scepticism; inferred.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Mixed constitution theory is not part of localism; dispersal of power is valued but through scale, not class balance.

equal-parenting.rationale: Custody presumptions are not discussed in localist sources.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: A debate internal to Marxism-Leninism that localism does not address.

land-redistribution.rationale: Berry favours small farms but redistribution is not stated.

refugee-return.rationale: Refugee return rights are not addressed in localist sources.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Civic localism is not ethnic, and Kohr opposed big-state expansion.

common-currency.rationale: Community banks and local economies favour local finance; inferred.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Self-governing local cultural institutions fit localism and Kohr's culture-based units.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: Localism values rootedness in place, but sources do not address persecuted minorities choosing between struggle and emigration.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Localist sources offer no theory of historical causation; Berry stresses values and neighbourliness while Schumacher stresses economic structure.

ban-cartels.rationale: Kohr opposed concentrations of economic power.

no-bailouts.rationale: Not addressed, though localists dislike large banks.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Judicial constraint on majorities is not addressed; localists favour local majorities deciding but give no source on courts.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Gender quotas for public bodies are not addressed by localist sources.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Some localists seek to minimise international trade and build local self-sufficiency, though a bloc of empire is different.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Localists would rather trade less than set standards in trade deals; split.

moral-incentives.rationale: Moral versus material incentives are not discussed, though Schumacher's enoughness hints at non-material motives; left neutral.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Hereditary titles are outside localism's concerns, and local loyalty to traditional institutions varies.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Local history, culture and identity is a localist value, though the scale is local rather than civilizational.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Rule by larger powers over smaller ones is opposed by Kohr.

patriotic-education.rationale: Localists want local rather than national loyalty; split.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Racial preference policy is not addressed by localist sources; adherents split.

public-money-creation.rationale: Money creation is not discussed beyond localists' interest in community banks and credit unions.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Localist sources do not address capitalism's crises or collapse; critics and moderates among adherents differ.

delink-world-market.rationale: Localists often align with anti-globalisation critics, but Monbiot's trade objection shows it is contested.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: A Marxist-Leninist thesis on imperialism that localist sources do not discuss.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Not addressed; localists favour community norms but not unlimited discrimination.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Constitutional entrenchment is not addressed in localist sources.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: The validity of colonial treaties is not addressed by localism.

minority-veto.rationale: Localism does not endorse a veto for every individual; local majorities decide; inferred.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: The right of resistance is not a stated localist doctrine, though dispersed power is valued; left neutral.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Not addressed; localists prefer local bodies.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Berry's farming stance accepts animal husbandry, inferred.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Berry's neighbourliness is horizontal, not hierarchical; not addressed.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Localists criticise consumption and homogenisation, but a theory of mass culture as pacifier is not stated, so adherents split.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Cultural hegemony theory is not part of localist thought.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Kohr and anti-globalisation localists criticise global economic bigness, but the surplus claim is not theirs.

native-born-offices.rationale: Reserving offices for the native-born is not addressed; civic localism cuts against it but the sources do not say so.

party-own-road.rationale: The independence of communist parties is a socialist debate localism does not enter.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Kohr opposed foreign aid for stifling local initiative.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Kohr opposed territorial disputes between big units; inferred.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: Localism supports local self-rule by residents but does not address indigenous leadership over settler descendants.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: Constitutional founding values of this kind are not addressed by localist sources.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: The comparison of fascism and communism is not a localist topic.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: A historical dispute outside localism; no localist source takes a position.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: Public attention to male disadvantage is not addressed by localist sources.

domestic-violence-symmetry.rationale: Domestic violence policy is not addressed by localism.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Locally appropriate institutions are consistent with localism, though stated about civilizations nowhere.

paid-care-work.rationale: Localists value household economies but sources do not discuss paying domestic labour.

filial-duty.rationale: Berry's household and kin ties, not addressed directly.

office-by-exam.rationale: Civil-service recruitment is not addressed; localist emphasis on participation and local choice cuts both ways.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Protectionist localists would block it, but mostly inferred from buy-local arguments.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Divorce law is not a localist concern.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Pension design is not addressed by localist sources, though community banks are valued.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Berry favours land tied to those who work it, but the tenure rule is not stated.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: Legislative control of budgets is not addressed; the doctrine concerns scale rather than institutions.

single-official-language.rationale: Kohr warned that large unions erode smaller languages and cultures.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Not addressed directly; residents-only ownership is a related localist idea.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: Anti-discrimination doctrine is not addressed by localist sources.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Berry names consumption among the ruling ideas to resist, and Schumacher's enoughness counters accumulation.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Domination of smaller states by large powers is what Kohr opposed.

corporate-influence.rationale: Kohr and Berry criticise large corporations; this ties to their critique.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Foreign funding of NGOs is not addressed; localist sovereignty concerns apply to the community, not the nation, so no clear stance.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Birth-rate policy is not discussed by localist sources; population views vary among greens and communitarians.

residents-only-property.rationale: Local control of land and community assets is core, and the Localism Act protects assets of community value.

job-guarantee.rationale: A federal job guarantee is not discussed; local employment is valued but a state guarantee is not addressed.

democratic-peace.rationale: Kohr blamed size, not regime type, for war.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Political obligation theory is not addressed by localist sources, though local consent matters; left neutral.

state-harmful.rationale: Kohr called himself a philosophical anarchist but localists generally want devolved government, not none, as the Localism Act gives councils broad powers.

local-production.rationale: The buy-local strand supports local production and consumption, and Berry argues for local food from small farms.

non-intervention.rationale: Localists favour self-determination of small communities and distrust distant power, which extends to non-interference between states; inferred.

industrial-unions.rationale: Union organisation is not addressed in the localist sources and adherents would have no common view.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Localism as defined here excludes ethnic or separatist nationalism, and nothing in its core doctrine supports conspiracy claims against a minority.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Marriage law is not addressed by localism and adherents range from conservative to progressive.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Localism's aim of letting residents take part in decisions rests on open local government, and the Localism Act 2011 gave communities rights to information and challenge.

informal-organisation.rationale: Localists favour community groups and small bodies, but also formal councils and neighbourhood plans, so views are split.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Localists distrust both distant national and supranational bodies and favour subsidiarity, so there is no clear ranking; inferred.

religious-nation.rationale: Localism ties identity to place and community, not to a shared religion, so it would reject a religious definition of the nation; inferred.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Localists distrust hierarchy and bigness (Kohr), so ritual submission to a dominant power is inferred to be unwelcome; the sources do not address tribute.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: Inferred from the decentralist preference for local control of resources and Kohr's case for small self-reliant units; the sources do not address regional fiscal transfers directly.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Berry and Schumacher favour widely held small property and household economies, which implies private personal belongings, though they reject collectivisation of productive property.

defeat-communism.rationale: Localism has no Cold War doctrine; Kohr opposed big-power blocs generally, so adherents are not committed to a crusade against communism.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: The Localism Act opens local services to community groups and other providers (right to challenge), implying mixed provision, but this is not a core doctrine.

religion-illusion.rationale: Localism is not an anti-religious doctrine, and Berry writes sympathetically of faith and community; inferred as disagreement with the claim that religion will fade.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Schumacher and Berry criticise industrial growth and capitalism's scale, but the sources do not judge its historical role; adherents are split.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Localism does not address gender equality or its economic basis; the sources give no ground for a position.

socialized-care.rationale: Berry's household and community economy emphasises family and neighbourhood work, so public provision of housework is inferred to be disfavoured.

purge-loanwords.rationale: Not addressed; localists defend local dialects and cultures, but official language purges are state-centred top-down measures they would not favour.

treaties-binding.rationale: Localism does not address treaties with internal nations; respect for local autonomy suggests mild support but adherents are not committed.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Decentralists favour small self-governing communities (Kohr, Schumacher), though not generally common ownership of all property, so support is moderate and inferred.

majority-settlement.rationale: Localists favour keeping communities local and self-determining; state steering of majority settlement into minority regions conflicts with that, inferred from principle.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Schumacher and Kohr reject both big capitalism and centralised state socialism in favour of small-scale, human-scaled economies (the "third way").

historical-land-claim.rationale: Inferred: localism favours the claims of the present community over remote historical claims.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Inferred: the ideology does not address it, and Holocaust denial is outside any localist strand.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Inferred: localism leaves social law to communities, and the strands are neutral on it.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Inferred: localism trusts communities and civil society, so suppressing independent organisations contradicts it.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Inferred: localism does not address blasphemy; its pluralist decentralism leans against it.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Inferred: Kohr and Schumacher distrust bigness and rule from afar, which covers colonies.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Inferred: localism favours consent of local people over rule by force.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Decisions taken by the people they affect, through neighbourhood bodies and community rights, is the core of localism.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Inferred: localism does not address it; scope notes most social questions are answered neutrally.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Inferred: decentralist and green thinkers drew on both conservative and radical ideas and distrusted the national left-right programmes.

alienated-labor.rationale: Inferred from Schumacher's concern that large-scale industry damages meaningful work.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Inferred: localism does not address the source of authority.

social-market-economy.rationale: Inferred from Schumacher and Berry's preference for local markets with limits on corporate bigness.

rich-first.rationale: Inferred: localists favour locally rooted, balanced economies over uneven growth in a few places.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Inferred: localism concerns subnational authority, not great-power blocs.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Inferred: localists want power held by accountable local communities, and hereditary rule runs against that.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Inferred from Schumacher's and Berry's preference for small, community-rooted institutions, which fits locally owned mutual banks.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: Inferred: localism concerns the level of decision-making and has no stated line on international lenders.

property-franchise.rationale: Localism's core is decision by the people affected, so a wealth-based franchise is contrary to it.

domination-women-nature.rationale: Inferred: Berry and Schumacher link care for land and community with rejecting exploitation, but ecofeminism is not core to localism.

reification.rationale: Inferred: Schumacher criticises the economics of bigness, but this Marxist framing is not part of localist writing.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Inferred: localists distrust concentrated power and favour local media and community meeting places.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: Inferred: local decision-making under known rules is compatible with, and implied by, the policy localism of devolution.

racial-franchise.rationale: The scope excludes ethnic localism, and the principle of decisions by those affected means all residents, not one group.

online-participation.rationale: Anachronistic: localism favours face-to-face community scale but is not hostile to online tools.

open-government-data.rationale: Inferred from the Localism Act's community rights and the localist aim of making local decisions open to residents.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Inferred: localism is silent on religion, and restricting marriage conflicts with its community-autonomy emphasis.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Inferred: localists favour buying from local shops, but singling out a religious minority is contrary to community-based values.

citizens-assembly.rationale: Inferred: neighbourhood planning and local referendums under the Localism Act share the idea of residents deliberating on decisions.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: Inferred: localism has no doctrine on religion; adherents range from religious communitarians to secular greens.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Inferred from its distrust of bigness; Schumacher and Berry criticise concentrated economic power, though localism does not centre on wealth.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Localism is indifferent to the question, which is left to local communities and national policy.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Inferred from the localist emphasis on community autonomy and decentralisation, which rules out a state-imposed belief system.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Inferred: localists want community-scale solutions and accountable local bodies, but not abolition of policing.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Localism favours devolved decisions but does not address consociational power sharing; adherents are split.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Berry and the localist strand see household and community self-reliance as better than distant government programmes.

term-limits.rationale: Not addressed; the strand cares about the scale of government, not office tenure.

vote-delegation.rationale: Not addressed; localists favour direct local participation but have no position on delegation.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: Not addressed; localists focus on community-scale concerns.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: Localism is indifferent to the question, which is left to each community and tradition.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Localism is indifferent to the question, which is left to each community and tradition.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Localism has no stated view on voting rights for non-citizens; adherents favour community control, and whether residents count as community members is not settled.

rent-control.rationale: Housing rents are not addressed; adherents could favour local control of housing but split on price caps.

abolish-ip.rationale: Inferred from the small-scale, rooted-economy emphasis, which has no stated view on patents; adherents would be wary of abolishing them wholesale.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Inferred from the decentralist distrust of national programmes that mobilise youth in the state's name.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Inferred from the green and human-scale strand, which distrusts large-scale dangerous technology; the sources do not discuss weapons.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: Inferred from the preference for local self-determination over distant powers; the sources do not discuss bases.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Recognition of past genocides is not an issue the localist sources address.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Inferred from Schumacher's and Berry's emphasis on meaningful work and household economies over rentier wealth.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Not addressed by localism; adherents are not committed to pacifism or to its rejection.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Localism uses local identity rather than national myth, and excludes ethnic nationalism in its scope, so grand national continuity claims are inferred to be disfavoured.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Localism takes no position on the philosophy of sex and gender.

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: Localism takes no position on feminist theory.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Inferred from localism's wariness of national symbolism and its exclusion of nationalist variants.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Localism is a political-economic doctrine of scale and not a spiritual-struggle view; inferred from its policy-focused character.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: Not addressed; localism concerns where communities live and decide, not diaspora relations.

culture-before-state.rationale: Localism concerns the level of decisions and local culture, but has no stated order of cultural renewal and state building.

god-not-male.rationale: Localism has no stated position on theology.

scripture-judged-by-women.rationale: Localism has no stated position on religious texts.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Localism favours locally rooted economies, but its scope excludes ethnic nationalism, so rule by a national majority group is inferred to be disfavoured.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Inferred from the localist preference for existing small, local units over merging them into larger territorial units.

independent-unions.rationale: Localism favours civil-society bodies rooted in the community and distrusts central control; inferred support for union independence.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: What counts as socialism is not discussed in the sources, so neutral is the honest answer.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Localism favours local control of services, and the Localism Act gave communities rights to run and keep local assets.

second-chamber.rationale: Chamber design is not discussed in the sources, so neutral is the honest answer.

municipal-property.rationale: Berry and localists favour community-rooted ownership and economies; inferred, not stated as municipal ownership.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Kohr and subsidiarity favour small self-governing units with limited central bodies; decisions stay local.

family-wage.rationale: Berry describes household economies and local loyalty; a wage that supports a family is inferred.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: Drug-approval speed is not discussed in the sources, so neutral is the honest answer.

ageing-research-funding.rationale: Schumacher's enoughness and limits stress acceptance of natural limits; costly ageing research is inferred as a low priority.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Payment privacy is not discussed in the sources, so neutral is the honest answer.

online-anonymity.rationale: Not addressed; localism prizes knowing neighbours, but online anonymity is not discussed.

person-over-state.rationale: Localism stresses community ties without a stated position on person versus collective.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Berry and Schumacher criticise materialist consumption and argue for meaning beyond it; inferred.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Policy localists accept central authority granting powers, while Kohr-style decentralists want entrenched small units; split.

gm-crops.rationale: Berry and Schumacher criticise industrial agriculture and favour appropriate technology; GM crops are inferred to be disfavoured.

dense-cities.rationale: Localists prefer small communities and rural economies and distrust bigness; inferred.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Localism is place-based, not racial, and excludes ethnic politics.

racial-pride.rationale: Pride in race or ancestry is not discussed in the sources, so neutral is the honest answer.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Kohr links bigness to war and favours small units that cannot wage aggressive wars; inferred.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Localists prize small, place-based communities over large national identities; inferred from their distrust of bigness, though sources do not address nationhood.

communal-electorates.rationale: Localism favours community decision-making by all residents of a place, not separate religious electorates; inferred, as sources are silent.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Localism has no theory of foreign plots against the nation; inferred from its non-nationalist, community focus.

free-public-college.rationale: Localism takes no line on tuition; some would back free access, others prefer locally funded institutions, so adherents split.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Schumacher and Berry argue for internalising environmental costs and curbing resource depletion, which fits making polluters pay, though they stressed limits more than taxes.

future-generations.rationale: Schumacher and Berry stress stewardship of land and finite resources for those who come after, a central green-localist theme.

women-distinct-values.rationale: Localism has no doctrine on gender; adherents split and the sources are silent.

arms-reduction.rationale: Kohr and Schumacher distrust large states and large-scale power, so lowering armaments is congenial, but this is inferred.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Localists favour transparent accountable decisions, but diplomacy is outside their concern; inferred from democratic accountability.

capital-controls.rationale: Berry and Schumacher want local capital to stay in local economies and distrust footloose global finance; inferred, with little on formal controls.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Not addressed; decentralists distrust central power but also support local order.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Kohr and Schumacher oppose large-state power and war; conscientious refusal is inferred, not stated.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Not addressed; local economies could use either collective or individual arrangements.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: Not addressed; central redistribution sits uneasily with local control.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Localism favours local fiscal autonomy but does not say whether national rules should bind governments.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Schumacher argued for appropriate technology and local production in developing countries, from which reform of global rules is inferred.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Localists seek to devolve power through reform, as in the Localism Act, rather than to smash the state.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Local control means each community chooses how to organise its economy; the Localism Act and Berry both stress local decision-making.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Schumacher calls natural resources irreplaceable capital but criticises valuing everything by market measures, so adherents are split.

sacred-nation.rationale: Localism puts the local community first and distrusts national grandeur; Kohr opposed large states.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Student loans are not addressed by localist writers, so no position can be inferred.

internal-colonialism.rationale: The centre-periphery critique of centralisation is congenial to decentralists, though they rarely use colonial language.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Not addressed directly; Schumacher's human-scale ideas imply some human needs but do not state a view on redesigning nature.

public-service-media.rationale: Not addressed; local media is favoured but public funding is not discussed.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Localism is silent on religion, and adherents hold varied views.

farm-price-support.rationale: Inferred from Berry's defence of small farmers and local food economies against distant markets.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Inferred from Schumacher's critique of nuclear power and of large-scale, high-risk technology.

workers-own-party.rationale: Localism does not address party organisation; it spans left and right.

ban-fgm.rationale: Inferred: mainstream localism devolves decisions but within general human-rights law, so adherents would back such a ban.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Inferred from general liberal equality norms in policy localism; localism itself does not address it.

one-language-many-names.rationale: Inferred from its respect for local identity and distinctiveness, which extends to local speech varieties.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Berry-style accountability to the neighbours harmed favours local remedies, but policy localism accepts regulation; adherents split.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Localism favours local bodies, not necessarily hereditary chiefs, and adherents are split.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Inferred from Schumacher's and Berry's stress on stewardship and limits to growth.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Inferred from its preference for discretion close to the case and distrust of centrally imposed rules.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Not addressed by localism; adherents are split between welcoming and requiring integration.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: Localism does not address union rules; adherents are indifferent.

voter-id.rationale: Election rules are not addressed by the ideology.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: Localism is about scale of decision-making and not about religion.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Localists want people to take decisions directly where they live, so competitive elections of rulers alone are not enough.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Inferred from the distrust of top-down control and its stress on community self-rule.

negative-income-tax.rationale: Not addressed; decentralists favour small-scale mutual provision but do not take a common stand on cash transfers.

women-suffrage.rationale: Not directly addressed; inferred from the broad inclusion of all community members in local decisions.

race-social-construct.rationale: Not addressed by the ideology, as the scope notes.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: Not addressed; localists prefer local bodies to national agencies but make no gender-specific claim.

homestead-ownership.rationale: Inferred from Berry's view of land as a community trust to be cared for locally, which sits uneasily with ownership by first claim.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Inferred from Kohr's opposition to supranational bodies and large units, which would not favour courts above the nation.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Localism has no doctrine on scripture; adherents include religious and secular people.

gendered-self-government.rationale: Inferred from its call for decisions by those affected, which implies local groups should include all their members.

defend-planned-state.rationale: Inferred from Kohr's critique of bigness and central planning, which would not favour defending a large planned state.

indirect-election.rationale: Inferred from subsidiarity and devolution, which fit councils at each level sending delegates upward.

national-church-status.rationale: Inferred from localism's focus on community self-government, which gives no support to a privileged national church.

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: Kohr argued for small units and accepted secession, so autonomy for minority-majority regions follows from the creed.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: Localism favours local decisions by residents, and the Localism Act 2011 uses neighbourhood referendums for such choices.

keep-colonial-borders.rationale: Inferred from Kohr's support for breaking up large states into small ones, which does not honour inherited colonial borders.

simple-living.rationale: Schumacher's 'enoughness' and Berry's thrift and household economies praise limited needs and local self-provision.

restrict-indigenous-settlement.rationale: Inferred from localism's wish to keep communities rooted and its caution about immigration, noted in the strand summary.

equal-conscription.rationale: Localism does not address conscription; adherents split and the sources give no line.

homeland-spiritual-bond.rationale: Wendell Berry's attachment to place and care for the land suggest a sense of duty to it, but the sources do not call it spiritual or national.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: Localism stresses accountable, community-based decisions, so it is inferred to reject unaccountable killing without trial.

close-ties-china.rationale: Localism prefers local over global ties and does not address great-power alignment.

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: Kohr favours small self-contained states over interventions abroad; inferred.

resources-common-ownership.rationale: Schumacher treats natural resources as capital to be preserved for all, which suggests shared ownership; inferred.

self-ownership.rationale: Localism does not address self-ownership, and adherents are split between libertarian and communitarian views.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: Consumption tax is not addressed by localism.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: Localism does not address targeted versus universal social spending, and community-run services could take either form.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: The Localism Act works through councils and neighbourhood bodies, which place organised local groups between citizens and government; inferred.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Berry criticises corporate favouritism and favours small local firms; inferred, as it is not a stated policy.

no-denominational-politics.rationale: Localism does not address religious organisation in politics.

tech-with-ancestral-values.rationale: Schumacher's appropriate technology fits small-scale tools with human and community values; inferred.

wife-divorce-without-consent.rationale: Localism does not address family law, and adherents are split.

national-resource-control.rationale: Localism favours control of resources by the community affected and opposes distant owners; inferred.

distribution-by-process.rationale: Not addressed; localists emphasise rootedness in place rather than a theory of just distribution.

financial-transactions-tax.rationale: Inferred from localist distrust of global finance and the preference for local economies; not stated as a position.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: Localism does not address racism; sources note only that populist variants use local identity in different ways.

unjust-law-not-binding.rationale: Not addressed; localism concerns where decisions are made, and adherents are split on the authority of unjust law.

automate-paid-work.rationale: Schumacher argued for appropriate technology and meaningful human-scale work rather than replacing labour, and Berry stresses the value of work.

multipolar-world.rationale: Kohr argued against bigness and supranational unions in favour of many small independent units, which matches a multi-centred world.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; neither Schumacher, Kohr nor Berry stated a theory of value on this point.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Local loyalty is central, but localism is distinct from nationalism and says little on working-class politics, so adherents are split.

material-over-identity.rationale: Not addressed; localism is indifferent to the left's internal priorities.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: Inferred from its preference for decentralised, community-based decisions over centrally led economic systems.

missingStatements.text: Public services and planning decisions should be controlled by neighbourhood or community bodies rather than by national government.
missingStatements.rationale: The Localism Act's neighbourhood plans, community rights to challenge and bid, and general power of competence embody this.

missingStatements.text: Communities should be able to take ownership of local assets such as shops, pubs and land when they come up for sale.
missingStatements.rationale: The Act's assets of community value let communities list local assets and bid for them.
missingStatements.declined: Specific to the UK Localism Act's mechanisms; decide-locally covers the underlying position.

missingStatements.text: Food and goods should mainly be produced and bought close to where they are consumed.
missingStatements.rationale: The buy-local strand supports local production and consumption, and Berry argues for local food from small farms.

missingStatements.text: Social and political units should be kept small, since the larger a state or firm grows the more dangerous and less accountable it becomes.
missingStatements.rationale: Kohr's core thesis in The Breakdown of Nations and Schumacher's small-is-beautiful principle.
missingStatements.declined: Political scale is covered by decide-locally and firm scale by widespread-small-property.

notes: Localism is a family of thin, scale-based doctrines rather than a full programme; adherents range from green-left decentralists to conservative and populist localists, so most economic-redistribution and cultural-moral statements are left neutral or low confidence.
